name: Yoriko
source:
The virtual representation of Fushiko in the game titled "Dog Livelihood VR."

After discovering that the VR game has a hidden adult (18+) mode, she explores and indulges in various acts of bestiality which become increasingly humiliating as a submissive persona is developed.

[spoiler]As the master-servant relationship with owner and pet continues to erode, she finds herself overwhelmed by lust and unable to escape the pleasures of animal love culminating in her abandoning the boundary between both identities and ultimately embracing sexual slavery in all aspects.

Depending on the player's choices, the events leading up to the final conclusion can consist of non-consensual bestiality and/or pregnancy alongside childbirth.[/spoiler]
